verdict.rationale: Medusa is explicitly described as a headless commerce platform with an installable open-source npm package and CLI (medusa-comm-3, medusa-gh-2, medusa-probe-4, medusa-docs-29), and cloud tooling references PR previews and background workers suggesting CI/automation support (medusa-docs-11, medusa-docs-30). However there is no explicit documentation of running Medusa in a CI pipeline or automated test/build scripts, and community notes flag unresolved serverless/background-job execution concerns (medusa-comm-2). Missing for 10: dedicated CI/automation guide, evidence of headless test execution, and independent confirmation of serverless/CI deployment working smoothly.
